Crop of one slip from a Players Committee Virtual card sheet, showing the label above the slip and the margin note beside the slip number, for [[I've Lost Artoo (V) (Virtual Set 11: Gathering Storm) (Remastered 2006)|I've Lost Artoo (V) (Virtual Set 11: Gathering Storm)]]: the label and the margin note both print "•I've Lost Artoo (V)" without the "!" of the Decipher card [[I've Lost Artoo!]].

Source: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154617/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards11.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards11.pdf], Virtual Set 11 Remaster sheet ("official text as of December 4, 2006"), page 3, slip 25. Internet Archive copy of 24 October 2007.

Edits: the slip area was rendered from the PDF at 216 dpi and cropped; nothing else changed. Used on [[PC Legacy Virtual Transcription Error History#Slip labels and margin notes]].

Fair use rationale: a low-resolution excerpt of a Players Committee fan document showing copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game artwork (© Lucasfilm Ltd.), used only to document the printed text on this non-commercial fan wiki.
